# Supplier Confirmations

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Screens” instructions below.

Purchasing records supplier commitments. Only Inventory posts physical receipt.

Use the PO **Record supplier response** action or the Purchasing follow-up list to review a confirmation on a sent order. Enter the supplier's actual line-by-line confirmed quantities and promised dates. Partial or rejected answers remain follow-up work. If eligible, use **Request follow-up commitment** to record new evidence while preserving prior responses.

Do not treat any confirmation status as physical warehouse receipt. Only an authorized Inventory receipt completed against a PO allocation updates on-hand stock and received PO totals.
